purpose: Teach: アドベンチャー/ヒルトン/ハーレム/エイリアン/ゴルファー/トークショー/東映/バイエルン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、アドベンチャーゲームがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, apparently this customer loves adventure games.
lines.style: Soft, almost amused discovery. Sharing something small she learned. Warm but reserved, letting the fact sit. No urgency.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ヒルトンホテルにご家族とお泊まりだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, apparently this customer stayed at the Hilton with their family.
lines.style: Lighter observation, settling in. Conversational, the tone of someone noticing something small about someone they see. Slightly wondering.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、漫画のハーレム作品にお詳しいって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, apparently this customer really knows their harem manga.
lines.style: Dry amusement underneath. A slight smile in the voice. Acknowledging something funny without making too much of it. Quick and knowing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、エイリアンの映画を観てこられたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, apparently this customer went to see that alien movie.
lines.style: Simple, factual, but with the warmth of someone enjoying the accumulation of these small details. Steady. No performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、プロのゴルファーでいらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, apparently this customer is a professional golfer.
lines.style: Gentle surprise underneath the calm delivery. Slight pause before the fact lands. Noticing something that explains something else. Reflective.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、テレビのトークショーに出演されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, apparently this customer appeared on a TV talk show.
lines.style: Steady, impressed but understated. The voice of someone building a picture of who this person is. No fanfare, just noting it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、東映の時代劇がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, apparently this customer loves those Toei period dramas.
lines.style: Warm, settling back into easy rhythm. The tone of accumulated knowledge about someone becoming affection. Conversational and genuine.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、サッカーのバイエルンファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, apparently this customer is a Bayern Munich fan.
lines.style: Close, intimate, the final detail shared between friends. Soft voice, slight smile underneath. A small moment of connection before it fades.
